description: Label/number manifest for the SE(3) arm-alignment schematic (conceptual diagram, no measurement data). Numbers are the CMO geometry descriptors quoted in the manuscript and the fitted per-channel SE(3) rotations from intermediate_state.npz (x_26p).
notes: Tilt is drawn exaggerated x6 for visibility; the real per-channel SE(3) rotation is a rigid rotation of the whole ray bundle (left 2.5 deg, right 3.7 deg), dominated by the x-component. Convergence half-angle = convergence_angle_deg/2.
